entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'd like to start a return for an order I placed a couple of months ago. My order number is VF886-0921.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up order VF886-0921... Okay, I see it here. It looks like you purchased the Pro-Vent Cycling Jersey. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with it?
Yes, it's just the wrong size. I thought a medium would work, but it's a race cut and it's just too tight across the shoulders for me. I'd like to do an exchange for a large if possible.

I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered 61 days ago. According to our policy for standard items like this jersey, you are well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process that exchange for you at no cost.

That's great news, I appreciate that. Since I have to go through the trouble of packaging it up and sending it back, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for a future purchase? Maybe 10%?

I understand the request, but our policy for a size exchange covers the cost of the return shipping and the new item's shipment, but it doesn't include promotional credits. I can assure you the process is very straightforward, and we'll get that new size out to you as soon as we receive the original.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. So, what are the next steps for the exchange?

I've just initiated the exchange in our system for a size large. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. Just print that out, attach it to the package with the original jersey, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we scan it into our warehouse, the new size will be shipped out to you immediately.
Okay, that sounds simple enough. I'll look for that email. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
